items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: golly, I'd never seen Al, uh, I wish I had the opportunity to meet him.

ctx.x: Um, well, you know, it's surprising how many of these people that come from other places know so much about, uh, you know, about, uh, Dixie Lounge. Uh, when we were over in Europe, uh, all these people would come up to us and they'd ask us if we knew, uh, George Lewis, uh, do we know Lawrence Marrera, do we know Al Hurt, and, uh, for the sake of a joke, I told them, I said, well, I taught Al Hurt to play a horn. And, uh, golly, I'd never seen Al, uh, I wish I had the opportunity to meet him. I like him, you see,…
Well, who, who did you hear over there? Did you listen to any bands on your way back?
